name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
description_en: The upstream CLI and MCP server for evidence-based investigations of shipped software and runtime behavior.
description_zh: REA 官方 CLI 与 MCP 服务，连接分析工具并保留调查证据及限制。
requirements: rea-agents 6.5.0 was the published npm version at review time.
Node.js ^22.19.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0; additional tools depend on the target.

name: Official reverse-engineer-anything skill
description_en: Target routing, connection recovery and evidence practices for agents using REA.
description_zh: 官方面向使用者的调查技能，包含目标路由、连接恢复与证据工作流。
requirements: Installing the skill provides instructions; it does not by itself register MCP or install analysis engines.
Use the connected server's actual tool schemas; repository main may be ahead of an installed release.

name: Installation and client setup
description_en: Reviewed setup plans, client registration, provider prerequisites and scoped readiness checks.
description_zh: 安装、客户端配置、分析引擎依赖及按任务检查就绪状态的官方入口。
requirements: Supported Node.js and npm.
Setup previews client configuration changes; native engines have separate prerequisites.

name: CLI and Evidence
description_en: CLI workflows for saving Evidence and projecting smaller views from completed analysis.
description_zh: 保存完整 Evidence，再提取摘要或模块视图，适合脚本与可复现记录。
requirements: Installed REA CLI or an explicitly pinned package runner.
CLI processes are separate; retain result files for later operations.

name: MCP contracts and generated catalog
description_en: Canonical tool contracts, provider discovery and Evidence semantics for integration authors.
description_zh: 官方工具协议、能力发现和 Evidence 语义；适合集成与核对实际工具边界。
requirements: A compatible MCP client for live use.
Discover the live catalog before relying on tools documented on main.

name: Native binary investigation
description_en: Locate a function, inspect instructions and pseudocode, and follow references with a selected native provider.
description_zh: 从函数清单到指令、伪代码和引用链的原生二进制调查流程。
requirements: A target binary and a configured supported provider such as Ghidra, Hopper or IDA.
Host, architecture and provider support are scoped separately; pseudocode is not original source.

name: Cross-layer JavaScript application workflows
description_en: Trace features and compare authenticated JavaScript application graphs while preserving static-analysis limits.
description_zh: 从 JavaScript 应用图追踪功能、比较版本，同时保留静态分析的不确定性。
requirements: Evidence from analyze_javascript_application or supported runtime reconciliation.
No native engine is required for the static JavaScript path; keep the complete parent Evidence.

name: Static Android APK analysis
description_en: Inspect Android package identity, classes, methods and references through REA's JADX integration.
description_zh: 经 REA 的 JADX 集成检查 APK、类、方法与引用；结果不等于运行时验证。
requirements: Full JDK 17 or newer and caller-supplied jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1 with the documented digest check.
Linux requires a procps-compatible ps for provider process ownership.

name: Managed-code analysis
description_en: Read PE/CLI metadata and CIL, compare managed members and inspect declared native boundaries without loading the assembly.
description_zh: 静态读取 .NET 元数据与 CIL，比较成员并检查声明的原生代码边界。
requirements: A supported PE/CLI assembly; no native engine is required for metadata/CIL inspection.
NativeAOT, IL2CPP and packaged single-file deployments have different boundaries.

name: Historical web network captures
description_en: Inspect saved web captures offline; recorded URLs are not fetched and no proxy is started.
description_zh: 离线检查已有 HAR、SAZ 等网页流量记录；不会自动抓包或访问记录中的 URL。
requirements: A supported existing capture and an explicit format selection.
PCAP/TShark workflows are separate and have different host/tool requirements.

name: Firmware analysis
description_en: Inspect firmware regions with Binwalk and explicitly extract with Unblob, retaining tool and artifact identity.
description_zh: 用 Binwalk 检查固件区域、用 Unblob 显式提取，并记录工具与制品身份。
requirements: Caller-supplied Binwalk 3.1.x for inspection; Unblob 26.6.x for extraction.
The documented verification scope is Linux x64; extraction needs a new caller-selected output directory.

name: Recorded packet capture inspection
description_en: Select TShark fields, display filters and decode-as rules over an existing network, USB or Bluetooth capture, and look up installed field names. It does not capture traffic, open an interface or control a device.
description_zh: 用 TShark 字段、显示过滤器和 decode-as 规则检查已有的网络、USB 或蓝牙抓包，并可查询已安装的字段名；不抓取流量、不打开网络接口，也不控制设备。
requirements: Caller-supplied TShark 4.x on Linux with util-linux prlimit; macOS and Windows hosts are refused before inspection. Listed in the rea-agents 6.5.0 release notes.

Dissector output describes the selected recording, not verified device behavior. Upstream fixtures are generated Ethernet/UDP/DNS and Bluetooth HCI PCAPs; PCAPNG, USB, BLE ATT and physical capture are not established by them.

name: Packet capture summaries
description_en: Summarize a saved pcap or pcapng file’s endpoints, DNS questions and addresses, TLS SNI, protocol stacks and HTTP URIs into paged Evidence views. It does not capture traffic or fetch recorded targets.
description_zh: 把已保存 pcap/pcapng 文件中的端点、DNS 查询与地址、TLS SNI、协议栈和 HTTP URI 汇总为可分页的 Evidence 视图；不抓取流量，也不访问记录中的目标。
requirements: Caller-supplied Wireshark 4.x tshark and capinfos. Capture inspection needs Linux with util-linux prlimit or Windows Job Objects; macOS reports a capability gap. Listed in the rea-agents 6.5.0 release notes.

Upstream’s current verification used Linux, Node 24.18.0 and Wireshark 4.0.17; actual Windows execution is unverified. Summaries do not establish decrypted payloads, process identity or the absence of unrecorded traffic.

name: Recorded signal decoding
description_en: Run caller-chosen sigrok protocol decoders, such as UART or I2C, over an existing logic-signal recording and keep annotation text with sample ranges. It does not acquire samples or communicate with hardware.
description_zh: 用调用方指定的 sigrok 协议解码器（如 UART、I2C）解码已有的逻辑信号记录，并保留带采样区间的注释文本；不采集样本，也不与硬件通信。
requirements: Caller-supplied sigrok-cli 0.7.2 with libsigrokdecode on Linux, plus util-linux prlimit; macOS and Windows are refused. Listed in the rea-agents 6.5.0 release notes.

The caller supplies decoder stacks, channel names and settings such as baud rate. Upstream’s fixture is a synthesized 9600-baud UART VCD; other formats, decoders and physical acquisition are not established.

name: Browser observation guide
description_en: Follow a user-triggered export request in the supplied Notes browser example and connect it to the downloaded result.
description_zh: 通过官方 Notes 示例关联用户点击、导出请求与下载结果；REA 负责观察。
requirements: A user-owned Chrome-family browser, loopback CDP connection and explicitly allowed origins.
The recorded upstream example used a separate controller to click; REA did not perform the click.

name: Aegis: trace a login-code calculation
description_en: An official APK investigation follows TOTP methods in Aegis and publishes artifact identities and selected Evidence.
description_zh: 追踪 Aegis APK 的 TOTP 计算，官方公开目标指纹与选取的调查证据。
requirements: Upstream case: Aegis 3.4.3, REA 6.1.0, jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1 and OpenJDK 21 on Linux x64.
Use the matching official APK for reproduction; this listing did not rerun the case.

name: DownUnderCTF: masked-squares flag checker
description_en: An official educational challenge investigation connects binary checks to equations and records an original-program validation.
description_zh: 官方教育 CTF 案例：从检查函数得到方程，并记录原程序验证过程。
requirements: Upstream case: public DownUnderCTF 2023 challenge, REA 4.1.0 and Ghidra 12.1.4 on Linux x64.
Target hash and source revision are documented; author-reported execution was not repeated here.

name: DX-Ball: reconstruct sound panning
description_en: Recover one sound-pan function from instructions and constants; upstream cites 3,205 cases and a 63-byte match.
description_zh: 根据指令与常量重建单个声像函数；上游报告 3,205 例与 63 字节匹配。
requirements: The matching DX-Ball 1.07 executable and the documented native-analysis environment.
The cited reconstruction checks concern one function, not full-game equivalence; no checks were rerun here.

name: Notion: trace the clipboard bridge
description_en: Trace a packaged Electron clipboard path using REA findings and separate source inspection; the dynamic wrapper remains a stated limit.
description_zh: 结合 REA 发现与独立源码阅读追踪剪贴板桥；动态包装器仍有明确限制。
requirements: Upstream case uses Notion Desktop 7.6.1 packaged JavaScript and REA 4.1.0.
The full clipboard route was not automatically paired or observed as a desktop execution.

name: TH04: recover a DOS bullet-ring helper
description_en: Inspect a 16-bit PC-98 DOS helper and relate its angle calculation to a pinned reconstruction and historical compiler checks.
description_zh: 检查 PC-98 DOS 的 16 位弹幕角度辅助函数，并关联固定版本重建与历史编译器检查。
requirements: The matching original TH04 MAIN.EXE and the documented Ghidra DOS load profile.
The showcase covers one helper; full-game reconstruction claims are outside its scope.

name: JavaScript and Electron: follow a CSV export
description_en: A source-owned Notes fixture teaches the renderer, preload, IPC and CSV path with linked analysis evidence.
description_zh: 官方自建 Notes 样例，从 renderer、preload、IPC 到 CSV 导出建立证据链。
requirements: Supported Node.js and REA; no native engine is required for this static fixture.
The fixture is source-owned teaching material, not an installed Electron distribution; static findings do not prove execution.

name: rea-playbook
description_en: An Electron practice target, Evidence extractor and MCP probe; offline fixture mode is distinguished from real REA analysis.
description_zh: 提供 Electron 练习目标、Evidence 提取与 MCP 探测，区分离线展示和真正调用 REA。
requirements: README pins the real-analysis path to rea-agents 6.3.0 and lists supported Node.js versions.
The offline demo reads bundled results without running REA; its tests were not rerun here.

name: dsh-mcp-rea
description_en: A community MCP bridge presents a smaller selected tool surface and forwards explicit commands to the REA CLI.
description_zh: 社区 MCP 适配桥，以精选工具和 CLI 转发缩小宿主需要处理的工具面。
requirements: Requires REA and the relevant analysis providers; distributed as a local bundle rather than a public npm package.
Use the documented REA_ENTRY mode for direct execution; PATH fallback invokes a shell.
Its README's provider/platform claims may lag upstream; no installation or security audit was performed.

name: rea-jev
description_en: A Claude Code plugin adds Jev-based routing and evidence checks around a pinned REA MCP integration.
description_zh: Claude Code 社区插件，在固定版本 REA MCP 外增加 Jev 路由和证据检查。
requirements: Claude Code, supported Node.js and the plugin's documented macOS/Linux environment.
Optional Jev service credentials enable external model calls; excerpts may be sent to that service.
Hooks fail open on provider failure; they are not a security guarantee.

name: rea-lab
description_en: A Windows REA/Ghidra lab with seeded challenges, published studies, upstream contributions and recorded limitations.
description_zh: Windows REA/Ghidra 实验室，提供已知答案挑战、公开研究、上游贡献与限制说明。
requirements: The documented environment uses Windows 11, REA 6.4.0 and Ghidra 12.1.4.
Study results are author-reported and task/model-specific, not independently reproduced by this index.
Code and documentation use different licenses; inspect the relevant repository notices.

name: rea-casebook
description_en: A Claude Code mod collects received REA Evidence, tracks unknowns and records findings that cite delivered evidence IDs.
description_zh: Claude Code mod 汇集收到的 REA Evidence、追踪 unknown，并校验发现所引用的证据 ID。
requirements: README requires Claude Code 2.1.296 or newer and an MCP server registered under the name rea.
Developed with REA 6.4.0 and Ghidra 12.1 on Windows; broader behavior was not tested here.
Evidence IDs being present does not itself prove a conclusion is correct.

name: PicoPrint: LX-D02 printer investigation
description_en: The author describes REA-assisted Android investigation followed by separate Hermes decompilation to support a Windows BLE printer.
description_zh: 作者报告以 REA 开始 Android 调查，再借助独立 Hermes 工具实现 Windows BLE 打印。
requirements: Project README lists Windows 10/11, Bluetooth LE, an LX-D02 printer and Go 1.25+ to build.
REA's stated role was readiness/device discovery and investigation framing; hermes-dec handled Hermes v98.
Hardware behavior and author-reported results were not reproduced here.

name: Awesome Reverse Engineering
description_en: A task-oriented reverse-engineering resource list by REA's maintainer, useful for broader tools and foundations.
description_zh: REA 维护者整理的通用逆向资源目录，适合查找基础知识与相邻工具。
requirements: Individual tools retain their own requirements and licenses.
Inclusion in this companion list does not establish REA integration or compatibility.

name: Awesome REA Cases
description_en: A bilingual collection of REA and other AI-assisted reverse engineering cases, with source links and explicit distinctions between reported and reproduced outcomes.
description_zh: 中英双语的 REA 与其他 AI 辅助逆向案例合集，附来源并区分作者报告、进行中的工作和复现状态。
requirements: A discovery index; review each case's original source, redistribution rights, and evidence status before reproducing it.

name: ReaCut: video-editor reconstruction
description_en: An independent video editor whose authors document REA-assisted investigation of Jianying/CapCut behavior and project formats. The public implementation includes a local timeline, FFmpeg export and an experimental, lossy draft importer.
description_zh: 独立视频编辑器，作者公开了利用 REA 研究剪映／CapCut 行为与项目格式的过程。实现包含本地时间线、FFmpeg 导出，以及实验性的有损草稿导入。
requirements: The v0.5.0 preview reports macOS Apple Silicon testing; Windows/Linux builds still need device validation. The macOS package is ad-hoc signed and not notarized.
The experimental importer is documented against controlled Jianying 11.0.12922 drafts. Basic conversions are lossy: effects, keyframes and styles can be lost, and projects cannot be written back.
REA supports the reported research workflow but is not a runtime dependency. The project uses its own code and format; MIT source and bundled third-party components retain separate licenses.

name: open-appleremote: Siri Remote protocol reconstruction
description_en: Reconstructs first-generation Siri Remote Bluetooth reports for Linux, decoding buttons, touch and tvOS-style gestures. The Python implementation and protocol notes distinguish measured behavior, historical reports and inferred meanings.
description_zh: 重建第一代 Siri Remote 在 Linux 上的蓝牙报告，解析按键、触摸与 tvOS 风格手势。Python 实现和协议文档区分实测行为、历史报告与推测含义。
requirements: Package 0.1.0; live use requires Linux, BlueZ, Python 3.8+ and access to the device’s hidraw interface. The core uses the Python standard library.
Project hardware checks cover A1962 with BlueZ 5.72 and Linux 6.17. A1513 is expected but untested; second- and third-generation Siri Remotes are unsupported.

The virtual keyboard has not been hardware-tested. Voice is unreleased and checked with synthetic or recorded frames, not live use in this package; it additionally needs libopus and HCI-monitor privileges.
Protocol notes label measured, previously reported and guessed facts. The public sample does not reproduce every claim from the larger unpublished capture.
MIT-licensed repository. REA use is not established by the reviewed project sources; device behavior was not independently reproduced.

name: GAMEKB-K17: reconstructing a macropad configuration protocol
description_en: Implements the vendor HID configuration protocol for the GAMEKB-K17/HCY-K017 macropad. It writes key mappings, firmware macros and RGB settings, then reads them back; protocol notes separate tested commands from unconfirmed observations and other-device findings.
description_zh: 实现 GAMEKB-K17/HCY-K017 宏键盘的厂商 HID 配置协议，写入按键映射、固件宏和 RGB 设置后再读回核对。协议文档区分已测试命令、未确认观察和其他设备的研究结果。
requirements: Package 3.0.0 requires Python 3.11+ and hidapi; the optional editor uses tkinter. Hardware identity is USB 0816:0220.
Windows is project-tested; other hidapi platforms are untested. Linux configuration requires suitable device permissions.
The documented scope includes 18 remappable controls and up to 16 firmware macros. The volume dial is fixed in firmware; family resemblance does not establish another model’s compatibility.
Read-back verification and interruption ordering are project claims backed by protocol documentation, not independent device tests by this catalog.
MIT license. The reviewed primary files establish reverse engineering of the vendor WebHID configurator, but do not establish REA involvement.

name: CF632BLE: a local client from scale-protocol research
description_en: Reimplements the CF632BLE scale’s BLE protocol and body-composition calculations from research on the vendor’s Unique Health Android app. A static Web Bluetooth client receives measurements, manages device profiles and keeps its history in browser storage.
description_zh: 根据对厂商 Unique Health 安卓应用的研究，重实现 CF632BLE 体脂秤的 BLE 协议和体成分计算。静态 Web Bluetooth 客户端接收测量数据、管理设备档案，并将历史记录保存在浏览器中。
requirements: Requires the CF632BLE hardware and a Chromium browser supporting Web Bluetooth in a secure context. Firefox and Safari/iOS cannot connect to the scale through this app.
The SvelteKit/Vite application builds with npm and a static adapter. Its documented measurement path has no application server or vendor backend dependency.
Single-user browser storage is localStorage. The Device tab can explicitly write device profiles and settings; local history and scale memory are different stores.
The reviewed README and package manifest give no project license, and no root LICENSE file was present at the pinned commit; public source availability is not a reuse grant.
Device compatibility and formula accuracy are project claims not independently tested here. The reviewed primary files do not establish REA use.

name: zee-rp: reconstructing supported Axure RP 11 document operations
description_en: Reads and rewrites supported native Axure RP 11 documents through a binary-record codec, reference-aware cloning and constrained interaction writers. CLI and MCP interfaces expose inspected edits while keeping offline structure checks separate from native application acceptance.
description_zh: 通过二进制记录编解码、考虑引用关系的克隆和受约束的交互写入器，读取并修改受支持的 Axure RP 11 原生文档。CLI 与 MCP 接口提供可检查的编辑操作，并区分离线结构检查和原生应用验收。
requirements: Package 0.1.1 requires Node.js 18+; MCP additionally uses the optional SDK dependency. Native creation needs the user’s Axure blank template and compatible libraries.
Recorded native acceptance uses macOS arm64 and Axure RP 11.0.0.4137. Linux CI covers public core checks; native GUI jobs require macOS and Accessibility permission.
Unsupported document forms, external references and interaction expressions may be rejected. Numbered lists and true native merged table cells are not supported.

Release evidence separates public/generated tests from historical assertions needing an unpublished exact fixture pack. One GUI sample checked load/save/close/reopen, not preview behavior or manual editing; newly synchronized features still need native acceptance.

Authored code/docs are MIT; Axure, its libraries and third-party assets are separate. Collection reports of REA use are not confirmed by the reviewed pinned project files; no tests were independently rerun.

name: Super Mario 64 DS: matching decompilation with relocation checks
description_en: Reconstructs Super Mario 64 DS functions as C/C++ and permitted assembly primitives, comparing compiled output with a user-supplied cartridge dump. Independent relocation-destination checks strengthen the matching gate; integration into the PC port is tracked separately.
description_zh: 将 Super Mario 64 DS 函数重建为 C/C++ 和规则允许的汇编原语，并将编译结果与用户提供的卡带转储对比。独立的重定位目标核对强化匹配检查；PC 移植中的集成进度另行统计。
requirements: Requires the user’s cartridge dump, the pinned mwccarm matching compiler, its separate linker/setup and Python tooling such as ndspy, Capstone and pyelftools.
The pinned README reports 11,389/11,389 matched functions, including 108 byte-exact assembly primitives, but only 10,957 linked into the PC port. These counters describe different gates.

The same README retains older near-finished prose, and port/README.md describes a historical smoke-build stage. Treat matching and port-playability statements as source-specific reports, not a verified complete playable port.
Agent-assisted matching is documented, together with source review and relocation checks. This review did not obtain a ROM, run the compiler or reproduce any counter.
The repository has an MIT license; original game data and external compiler rights remain separate. No REA affiliation is established.

name: GoldenEye 007: an agent-assisted native port from a decompilation
description_en: Builds a native PC port on the existing GoldenEye 007 decompilation, with a host platform layer and assets extracted from the user’s ROM. The project documents agent collaboration, rendering comparisons, playtest scope and unresolved platform support.
description_zh: 在已有 GoldenEye 007 反编译成果之上构建原生 PC 移植，提供宿主平台适配层，并从用户自己的 ROM 提取资产。项目记录智能体协作、渲染对比、试玩范围和尚未解决的平台支持。
requirements: The reviewed v0.5.0 documentation supports Windows 10/11 x64 and x86-64 Linux/Steam Deck with glibc 2.31+; both need OpenGL 3.0 drivers. macOS and ARM builds remain planned, despite the broader repository About description.
Release packages require the user’s US NTSC-U ROM; PAL and Japanese releases are not yet supported. This is a native port from decompiled source, not static binary recompilation.
Source builds need CMake 3.16+, C/C++, SDL2, zlib, OpenGL, Python 3 and the documented asset-extraction tools.

v0.5.0 playtests were campaign spot-checks and multiplayer sessions; the full Agent-difficulty campaign was last reported end-to-end at v0.4.0. Frame comparisons and playtests were not independently repeated here.

MIT covers original port/build/tooling/docs work only. NOTICE states inherited n64decomp/007 material has no explicit upstream license, and vendored components have separate terms; the MIT file is not a blanket grant over all contents.

name: ssbu-recomp: static recompilation with explicit mode limits
description_en: Translates Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4 AArch64 code ahead of time and supplies a Windows runtime with Vulkan/OpenGL rendering. It also reconstructs selected fighter scripts as editable C++ and compares translated/source behavior through differential and deterministic tests.
description_zh: 将 Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.4 的 AArch64 代码提前转换，并提供带 Vulkan/OpenGL 渲染的 Windows 运行时。项目还将部分角色脚本重建为可编辑 C++，通过差分与确定性测试对比转换代码和源码行为。
requirements: Running requires Windows 10/11 x64, a Vulkan 1.3-capable GPU and the user’s own 13.0.4 game dump. Linux and Steam Deck support have not started.

Building requires Python 3.10+ with the documented packages, LLVM/clang 9.0.0 (8.0.0 is also documented as working), MSVC/Windows SDK, SDL3, Vulkan headers, glslang and reference tooling. Music needs libopus; movies need Media Foundation, VP9 Video Extensions and Web Media Extensions 2.x, with Media Feature Pack additionally required on Windows N.

Only some modes have reported play coverage. Adventure maps/fights and several multiplayer modes are untested; online is unavailable. Physical controllers are not yet confirmed despite virtual-device tests.
The author credits Claude agents. Reported frame rates, differential equivalence and selected fighter match traces do not establish full-game equivalence; this catalog did not run them.
The README grants GPL version 3 or later. The public repository supplies tools/runtime rather than the game dump, keys or assets; game-derived output is a separate requirement.

name: KartPad: platform integration for a Mario Kart Wii recompilation
description_en: Builds Apple and Android integration around WiiCompiled’s ahead-of-time translation of Mario Kart Wii, with native graphics, input and optional Retro Rewind support. Its status and rights documents distinguish platform acceptance, unresolved device defects and game-content requirements.
description_zh: 围绕 WiiCompiled 对 Mario Kart Wii 的提前转换实现 Apple 与 Android 平台集成，提供原生图形、输入及可选 Retro Rewind 支持。状态和权利文档区分平台验收、未解决的设备缺陷及游戏内容要求。
requirements: Requires user-supplied supported PAL RMCP01 revision 0 game data. Retro Rewind 6.13.3 needs matching separately obtained content and a compatible compiled profile in the reviewed 0.8.3 build.

Android targets ARM64/Vulkan on Android 9+; iPhone/iPad require iOS/iPadOS 16+. The README documents a PadMint/source route for Apple Silicon macOS 14+, while the pinned status table still labels Mac experimental. tvOS 17+ is also an experimental preview.

Physical-device and emulator checks cover specific builds and devices. Missing graphics, freezes, controller and performance problems remain on some hardware; a successful Pixel or iPad test is not universal compatibility.
Substantial AI assistance is disclosed without an audited generated-code percentage. This catalog did not compile the project, obtain game data or reproduce tests.

KartPad-owned work is GPL-3.0-only, with upstream component terms retained. RIGHTS_AND_LICENSES separates software obligations from game-derived logic and assets; GPL does not relicense Mario Kart Wii.

name: BattleShip: an AI-assisted Super Smash Bros. native port
description_en: Ports the existing Super Smash Bros. N64 decompilation using libultraship and Torch. The author’s earlier README describes agent-built graphics/audio comparison tools and differential debugging against emulator behavior, rather than claiming AI recovered the game from a cartridge without prior community work.
description_zh: 使用 libultraship 和 Torch 移植已有的 Super Smash Bros. N64 反编译成果。作者早期的 README 介绍了智能体构建的图形、音频对比工具和对照模拟器行为的差分调试，并未将其说成脱离社区既有成果、仅靠卡带自动恢复游戏。
requirements: Requires the user’s own Super Smash Bros. N64 dump matching a documented hash: US NTSC-U v1.0 (NALE) or Japanese v1.0 (NALJ). Each region is a separate build; Torch extracts assets locally during a source build or on a packaged build’s first run.

The README lists native Windows, Linux, Apple Silicon macOS and Android builds; native C mods and the GameCube adapter driver are desktop-only. BUILDING.md covers desktop source builds with Git/submodules, CMake and Python 3, plus Ninja on Linux/macOS or Visual Studio 2022 and the Windows SDK on Windows.

The author reports developing the port alone with Claude until v0.3-beta and says it is no longer a pure AI project, crediting community testing, fixes and features. These statements are self-reported; ROM identity checks and described rendering/audio comparisons do not prove complete behavioral equivalence.

The LICENSE grants MIT only to port-specific code, build scripts, tools and docs. The decomp submodule and decomp-derived files defer to the upstream decompilation, which publishes no explicit license; libultraship/Torch, bundled fonts and controller mappings keep their own terms; game rights are separate.
This review read documentation and license scope only, without a game dump, build, emulator session or independent runtime reproduction. REA use is not established.

name: Agent decompilation: a byte-matching retrospective
description_en: Maurice Heumann describes replacing plausible-looking agent output with compiler-based checks of reconstructed functions, relocations, data and types. The retrospective reports 99% function presence and 83% of all functions byte-exact, while keeping the reconstruction code private.
description_zh: Maurice Heumann 介绍如何用基于编译器的函数、重定位、数据和类型检查，取代看似合理的智能体输出。复盘报告 99% 的函数已进入重建源码，全部函数中 83% 达到字节一致；重建代码仍不公开。
requirements: Author retrospective dated 2026-10-09; the reviewed article leaves the game unnamed.
The project uses the original compiler and binary as references; no public implementation or reproducible artifact is supplied.
Coverage figures and runtime success are author-reported, not independently reproduced.
A documented case study, not an available game port or an established REA integration.

name: Snowboard Kids 2: an LLM-assisted N64 matching decompilation
description_en: A public matching decompilation of the N64 game Snowboard Kids 2, begun in 2024 with community decompilation tools. The author’s dated posts document Claude, Codex and GLM workflows, including headless one-shot loops, similarity-based function scheduling and hook-guarded, hash-checked builds, through a reported complete function match.
description_zh: N64 游戏 Snowboard Kids 2 的公开匹配反编译项目，2024 年借助社区反编译工具启动。作者在按日期发布的文章中记录了 Claude、Codex 和 GLM 的使用流程，包括无界面的一次性匹配循环、按函数相似度安排任务，以及由钩子约束、经哈希校验的构建，直至报告全部函数完成匹配。
requirements: Building needs the user’s own big-endian Snowboard Kids 2 ROM, make, Python 3, MIPS binutils and the toolchain installed by make setup; the README reports testing only on x86 Debian/Ubuntu and macOS. It states the repository has no game assets or assembly, although the reviewed tree tracks menu-sprite PNG and palette files under assets/.

Progress figures are author-reported. The 2026-02-16 post describes matched code rising from about 25% to 58% with one-shot loops, then to about 75%, with 124 functions left; the 2026-05-17 post reports every function matched. The 2025-11-27 post’s 79% figure was a projection. This catalog did not build the ROM or check any figure.

Byte-matching C is not documented or idiomatic source. The 2026-05-17 post notes remaining __asm__ coercions, many generated names and structures still needing cleanup, and graphics/audio assets mostly handled as binary blobs; the 2026-02-16 post describes brittle agent matches.

Agent assistance is not quantified beyond the posts. The 2026-05-17 post dates the first commit to September 2024 and credits four named N64 decomp community members with significant contributions, especially across the final ten functions; the 2025-11-04 post describes a human-led loop. The work relies on community tools such as splat, m2c, decomp.me, asm-differ and decomp-permuter.

No license file is present at the reviewed commit. The June 2026 Snowboard Kids 2: Recompiled release and the August 2026 decompilation of the original Snowboard Kids are separate projects outside this record; no REA integration is established.

name: awesome-rea (yibie): verification-focused projects and practice reports
description_en: Organizes AI-assisted game decompilation, native ports, static recompilation and tooling around stated acceptance checks, alongside a separate track of practitioner write-ups and discussions. Useful for finding primary reports and comparing how projects define correctness.
description_zh: 围绕明确的验收检查整理 AI 辅助游戏反编译、原生移植、静态重编译和工具，并另设实践文章与讨论分类。适合寻找一手报告，比较不同项目如何定义正确性。
requirements: Project entries describe acceptance mechanisms; the separate discussion track does not require public code or an acceptance test. Listing is not independent runtime verification.
The reviewed snapshot has an intentionally empty console/firmware category. Do not infer implemented firmware coverage from the planned category.
Collection summaries can lag primary repositories, including platform support, progress and license scope; follow the linked project sources before relying on a claim.
The collection LICENSE declares CC0 1.0 Universal. Linked projects and source articles retain their own rights and license conditions.
An independent community collection; entries are not necessarily REA integrations, and the list is not an official upstream affiliation.

name: cooler-lcd: a Thermalright display protocol implementation
description_en: Implements a USB picture-transfer driver for Thermalright Vision cooler displays, with a Rust dashboard replacing the vendor display application. The documented protocol sends a header and JPEG frames, with periodic resends to prevent the device reverting to its logo.
description_zh: 为 Thermalright Vision 散热器显示屏实现 USB 图像传输驱动，并用 Rust 仪表盘替代厂商显示应用。文档所述协议发送报头和 JPEG 帧，通过定期重发避免设备退回品牌标志画面。
requirements: Package 0.1.0 uses Rust edition 2024 and targets the 480×480 USB 87ad:70db display family; other cooler/display models are not established by this review.
Its documented environment is Linux with udev/systemd and Omarchy integration. Hyprland supplies away/lock state; NVIDIA telemetry uses NVML, and individual screens need their own optional services.

The driver cites TRCC Linux reverse-engineering notes for its 64-byte frame header and JPEG payload, with one-second keepalive resends. Device handling and reported CPU/memory figures were not independently measured here.
Only one process can own the display at once; the vendor TRCC application must relinquish it. Preview rendering is not a hardware compatibility test.
MIT-licensed code. Optional traffic/map feeds and other external services retain their own terms. The primary files do not establish REA use.

name: IsaacRecomp: translating Flash game bytecode to native C++
description_en: Translates The Binding of Isaac’s Flash AVM1 bytecode into C++ functions and supplies a native rendering/input runtime. The project reads graphics and audio from the user’s original game and documents deterministic input, headless runs and screenshot regression checks.
description_zh: 将 The Binding of Isaac 的 Flash AVM1 字节码转换为 C++ 函数，并提供原生渲染与输入运行时。项目从用户自己的原游戏读取图像和音频，并记录了确定性输入、无界面运行和截图回归检查。
requirements: Requires the user’s original Steam Isaac.exe; Wrath of the Lamb and Eternal Edition depend on the corresponding game version. This is ahead-of-time translation, not recovery of the original authored ActionScript project.

Documented targets include 64-bit Windows/Linux, Android 7.0+ on 64-bit ARM and Switch homebrew. Source builds use CMake/Ninja and SDL2/OpenGL 3.3 or ES 3.0; mobile/console builds have separate SDK/toolchain requirements.
The author credits AI assistance and reports 30 Hz game logic with higher-rate interpolated rendering. Performance, gameplay parity and stability claims were not independently reproduced.
Reported regression tests compare deterministic logic and screenshots across engine revisions; they do not by themselves establish every behavior matches the original Flash game.

MIT covers the authored engine, tools, build files and docs only. LICENSE explicitly excludes gen/, gen720/, patch1080/ and patch720/ translated game-code directories; third-party and original-game rights remain separate.

name: Virtual Desktop Streamer: rehosting the platform layer on Linux
description_en: An author-reported Claude Code and REA workflow replaces the macOS streamer’s capture, encoding, audio and input layer with Linux implementations while reusing vendor protocol libraries. The documented result targets desktop streaming and video playback, not Windows-only VR game streaming.
description_zh: 作者报告通过 Claude Code 与 REA，将 macOS 串流端的捕获、编码、音频和输入层替换为 Linux 实现，同时复用厂商协议库。文档中的目标是桌面串流和视频播放，而非仅 Windows 串流端提供的 VR 游戏串流。
requirements: Requires the official macOS Virtual Desktop installer for proprietary libraries and the user’s Virtual Desktop headset application. It is not a complete protocol reimplementation or an official vendor port.

The build uses .NET 8. Linux runtime dependencies include GStreamer 1.16+, PulseAudio/PipeWire, X11 or an appropriate Wayland portal, OpenSSL 1.1 or 3 and uinput access; video-file playback additionally needs FFmpeg 7.

Published testing used a simulated headset, mock portal and container networking. No real headset, real Wi-Fi or GPU encoder was available; internet matchmaking and same-address network changes were untested.
The scroll fix was checked at device/libinput level without directly observing the receiving X11 app. This catalog did not repeat those tests or validate headset compatibility.
MIT applies to this repository’s code only. Vendor libraries remain proprietary; the project limits redistribution of packages containing them and does not grant rights to the headset application.

name: Open Claude UI: REA-informed interface reference components
description_en: Publishes React components, motion helpers and design-system notes derived from the author’s reported REA investigation of Claude Desktop. It is useful as an interface-reconstruction case, with version-specific observations rather than proof of a complete assistant application or backend clone.
description_zh: 发布 React 组件、动效辅助模块和设计系统笔记，作者将其归因于使用 REA 调查 Claude Desktop。它可作为界面重建案例；观察结果受版本约束，不能证明已完整复刻助手应用或后端。
requirements: Package 1.0.0 declares React/React DOM 18+, Framer Motion 10+ and lucide-react 0.280+ peer dependencies; its development setup uses TypeScript 5.5 and Framer Motion 11.
Versioned analysis explicitly targets Claude Desktop v2.37337.1 and reports REA v6.5.0. Earlier design notes and newer desktop observations should not be treated as one timeless specification.
The package exposes build/typecheck and a component preview; production-grade or high-fidelity wording remains the author’s assertion, without an independent comparison performed by this catalog.
UI component examples do not supply Claude model access, account services or a recovered complete desktop application. Native desktop effects require their own host integration.

MIT repository license. The asset policy documents system-font fallbacks and synthesized audio instead of bundled proprietary font/audio files; it does not grant rights in upstream Claude assets or branding.

name: Nanolathe: a documented Total Annihilation engine reimplementation
description_en: Reimplements a Total Annihilation-compatible strategy-game engine in Go, with public file-format research and separate gameplay profiles. It distinguishes intended retail 3.1 behavior from community-patch research and deliberate modern changes, and separates synthetic checks from tests requiring original game data.
description_zh: 用 Go 重实现兼容 Total Annihilation 的策略游戏引擎，公开文件格式研究并提供不同玩法配置。项目区分拟复现的零售版3.1行为、社区补丁研究和有意加入的现代改动，也区分合成检查与依赖原始游戏数据的测试。
requirements: Native use requires the user’s installed Total Annihilation HPI archives. The reference installation includes Core Contingency, Battle Tactics and patch 3.1; other combinations remain under testing.
The pinned source requires Go 1.27.1 or newer and Ebitengine 2.10.5. Native targets include Windows, macOS 13+ and Linux with graphical/audio libraries; the browser build remains experimental.
The project is beta. Modern rules intentionally change behavior, while Strict 3.1 expresses a compatibility aim rather than independent proof of full retail equivalence.
Synthetic tests run without retail assets; the separate retail tier requires an installed game. This catalog did not build, obtain game files or reproduce gameplay/rendering claims.

Original engine code is MIT; original game assets and dependency licenses are separate. The publication note describes curated integration snapshots, omitted raw research and unresolved attribution questions; those snapshots are not individually certified releases.

name: Awesome REA/Decompiled Games
description_en: Groups game decompilations, source reconstructions, recompilations, native ports and demos by original game, with comparison rows linking related projects. It distinguishes launchers, engine work and creator-shared showcases from source-reconstruction efforts.
description_zh: 按原游戏整理反编译、源码重建、重编译、原生移植和演示，通过对照表链接相关项目，并区分启动器、引擎工作、作者分享的展示与源码重建成果。
requirements: The reviewed README has 103 game headings and 140 project rows across 8 categories. Some headings cover related editions and one repository can appear under multiple games; these are inventory counts, not independently verified completed projects.

The scope extends beyond REA-assisted work. Contribution rules require project-owned evidence before describing REA use; a screenshot, demo or collection listing alone is not proof of a recovered source tree.
Project type, runtime status, original-game requirements and licenses must be checked at the linked primary source. Creator-shared original browser games are a separate showcase category.

The two reviewed files do not establish a collection-wide reuse license. Images have source links, and new-image contributions require reuse terms or permission; this catalog does not copy those images.
An independent discovery collection; inclusion does not imply official REA affiliation.

name: PlxNative: reconstructing a native webOS media-client interface
description_en: An unofficial Plex client built after the author investigated LG webOS native media interfaces with Ghidra and coding agents. It draws its own Rust/OpenGL interface and uses the television’s decoder, with documented host, simulator and real-device test tiers.
description_zh: 作者用 Ghidra 和编程智能体调查 LG webOS 原生媒体接口后构建的非官方 Plex 客户端。它自行绘制 Rust/OpenGL 界面并使用电视解码器，文档区分宿主测试、模拟器测试和实体设备测试。
requirements: Requires a Plex account/server and a compatible LG TV. The baseline is webOS 4.0+, with explicitly documented 3.4.3/3.9.3 exceptions; the latter needs a newer source build than prebuilt v0.8.0.
Developer Mode normally needs no root but requires renewal. Some k5lp/k3lp devices cannot play under its sandbox, and k6hp crashes remain unresolved; no universal LG-TV compatibility is claimed.
Product builds need macOS (x86_64 or arm64) or arm64 Linux, the webOS NDK, the pinned Rust toolchain and CMake. The desktop simulator has a different host/setup path.

The scope is movies and TV shows, excluding music, photos, live TV and DVR. Selected relay/encrypted-server paths lack end-to-end viewing tests; timing and playback results remain author/device-specific.

GPL-3.0-or-later for project code, with separate brand and third-party terms including bundled FFmpeg. This catalog did not install the client or reproduce TV tests; REA involvement is not established.

name: TH08: exact-source reconstruction and separately tested ports
description_en: Reconstructs the original Japanese Touhou 8 version 1.00d against its binary and original compiler, then adapts the recovered code for other platforms. Source presence, strict function matching, whole-executable identity and playable-port checks are recorded as different milestones.
description_zh: 依据原二进制和原编译器重建日版 Touhou 8 的 1.00d 版本，再将恢复的代码适配到其他平台。项目分别记录源码存在、严格函数匹配、完整可执行文件一致性和移植可玩性里程碑。
requirements: Exact checks require the user’s original Japanese TH08 1.00d executable and Visual C++ .NET 2002 toolchain. Ledgers and analysis helpers need Python 3.11+; Linux/macOS toolchain setup also needs Wine and msiextract. Playable products still need original game data.

The pinned main README reports source for 1,107 authored functions and strict acceptance of 1,106, with whole-executable identity still in progress. Linux/web playability and the separate portable-64bit branch do not imply complete binary identity.
The VC7 i386 runtime checkpoint is distinct from a redistributable modern Windows release; macOS remains in progress. Exact normal-build checks and bugfix playtests have different purposes.

A historical oracle accepted instruction bytes while missing wrong floating-literal data. The linked issue/PR records later data-reference checks; matching results support only the properties actually checked.

MIT covers repository code/docs, not the original game. Historical source lineage and agent contributions retain their attribution. No compiler, original game, replay or port was independently run for this catalog.

name: Dinosaur runner: recovering one acceleration rule
description_en: REA’s documented teaching case inspects the HTTP t-rex-runner edition and reconstructs its speed-update rule. A separate controlled original-game check and a new demonstration compare update counts, including the floating-point step that crosses the nominal speed threshold.
description_zh: REA 的教学案例检查 HTTP 版 t-rex-runner，并重建其速度更新规则。单独进行的受控原游戏检查与新演示对比更新次数，包含浮点递增越过名义速度阈值的一步。
requirements: The recorded target is wayou’s HTTP browser edition at the cited revision, not chrome://dino/. Source and observation hashes identify that edition.

After read-only inspection, a separate Playwright controller disabled future scheduling and obstacles to call the original update function under controlled conditions; this was not passive REA behavior.
The reconstructed claim is limited to acceleration. Drawing, jumping, collisions and controls in the teaching game are newly authored, not independently recovered original gameplay.
Public result tables and code document the author’s checks; this catalog did not rerun them. The cited original-source excerpts retain Chromium attribution and BSD-3-Clause terms.

name: Windows Calculator: reconstructing percentage rules
description_en: REA’s case traces the installed Windows Calculator model DLL to explain different percentage behavior for multiplication/division and other operations. An analyst-selected function is interpreted against public Microsoft source and demonstrated with fixed browser examples.
description_zh: REA 案例追踪已安装 Windows Calculator 的模型 DLL，解释乘除运算与其他运算中不同的百分比行为。分析人员选定函数后，对照微软公开源码解释，并通过固定输入的浏览器示例演示。
requirements: The documented target is Calculator 11.2508.4.0 x64. The public source commit is an interpretation cross-check, not an identified build commit for that installed DLL.
Function selection was analyst-assisted; the illustrative agent conversation is not a recording of fully autonomous discovery. No PDB symbols were loaded.
Microsoft source tests were inspected, not run, and no completed Windows GUI input check is claimed. Browser checks exercise the explanatory examples only.
This reconstructs a bounded arithmetic rule, not the Calculator application. Public Microsoft source is MIT-licensed; access and rights to the installed target remain separate.

name: Feishu: an author-reported isolated second app instance
description_en: The author reports using Codex and REA analysis to adapt a separate macOS Feishu copy with its own application identity, data directory and single-instance lock. The account describes local signing and separation checks while retaining the original app unchanged.
description_zh: 作者报告借助 Codex 与 REA 分析，修改独立的 macOS 飞书副本，为其设置不同的应用身份、数据目录和单实例锁。文章描述本地签名与隔离检查，并称原应用保持不变。
requirements: The report targets Feishu 8.1.17 with REA 6.5.0 on the author’s Mac; reported elapsed times and isolation results were not independently reproduced.
The modified copy is locally signed and has automatic updates disabled. The article does not publish a redistributable replacement app or original-source reconstruction.
The author attributes some architecture tracing directly to Codex and cites prior feishu-clone work; the outcome should not be credited solely to REA.

Original hash/signature and process/data separation checks are author-reported. This case does not establish compatibility with later versions, vendor approval or rights to redistribute a patched application.

name: Zelda 64: Recompiled — a native Majora’s Mask port without a full source decompilation
description_en: Uses N64Recomp to translate Majora’s Mask into a native application and RT64 for rendering. The project separates static recompilation from source decompilation while reusing decompilation headers and selected functions for patches and enhancements.
description_zh: 通过 N64Recomp 将《姆吉拉的假面》转为原生应用，并使用 RT64 渲染。项目区分静态重编译与源码反编译，同时借用反编译项目的头文件和部分函数实现补丁与增强功能。
requirements: The reviewed build accepts the US Nintendo 64 Majora’s Mask ROM supplied by the user; game assets are not included. Ocarina of Time remains planned, and this is not an emulator for arbitrary ROMs.

Runtime graphics require Direct3D 12.0 with Shader Model 6, Vulkan 1.2, or Metal Argument Buffers Tier 2. x86-64 needs SSE4.1; the README lists macOS 13.0+ with Apple Silicon or a 7th-generation Intel CPU.

Source builds additionally require submodules, CMake 3.20+, C++20 tooling, N64Recomp/RSPRecomp and the specified decompressed ROM. The build guide lists SDL2 and platform dependencies; ordinary play uses the standard ROM.
The project documents high-frame-rate, widescreen, camera and save enhancements, plus overlay and cutscene issues. These are project claims, not independently rerun fidelity or performance checks.

GPLv3 project license; original game content and dependencies retain separate terms. The team states that it does not use generative AI and bans contributions using GenAI tooling in any capacity; this is not an REA-assisted case.

name: OpenGOAL: recovering GOAL code and rebuilding the Jak games
description_en: Reconstructs readable GOAL code from the original Jak binaries and compiles it with a new GOAL compiler for modern PCs. Its workflow combines a specialized decompiler, manually supplied type information, asset extraction and an interactive development runtime.
description_zh: 从 Jak 原二进制重建可读的 GOAL 代码，再用新编写的 GOAL 编译器为现代 PC 编译。流程结合专用反编译器、人工补充的类型信息、素材提取和交互式开发运行时。
requirements: Requires the user’s original PS2 game copy and extracted assets. The README covers retail PAL, NTSC and NTSC-J editions, including Greatest Hits, and excludes later PS3/PS4/PS5 releases.

The pinned README reports Jak 1 as complete, Jak 2 as beta with remaining issues, and substantial work still needed for Jak 3. These are distinct milestones, not a claim that the entire trilogy is finished.

The supported runtime is x86-64 on Windows, Linux and macOS. The macOS guide requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon and lists macOS Sequoia; native ARM64 builds are experimental and unsupported. No mobile release is planned.

Development uses C++20, CMake, NASM and platform libraries, then the project’s asset-extraction and GOAL compilation steps. The documented task commands need the corresponding task runner; runtime code editing is a development feature.
ISC license for project work; original game assets and third-party components retain their own rights. REA involvement is not established, and this catalog did not build or run the games.

name: LEGO Island: source reconstruction with separately reported exact rebuilds
description_en: Reconstructs the English LEGO Island 1.1 source for its original 32-bit Windows target. The project distinguishes function-comparison reports, ReproBit’s reported byte-identical retail rebuilds and ordinary developer builds; its modern portable adaptation is a separate repository.
description_zh: 针对英文版 LEGO Island 1.1 的原始 32 位 Windows 目标重建源码。项目区分函数对比报告、ReproBit 报告的零售版逐字节一致重构建，以及普通开发构建；现代跨平台适配位于另一仓库。
requirements: Exact verification requires the user’s matching English 1.1 CONFIG.EXE, ISLE.EXE and LEGO1.DLL, the original Visual C++ 4.2 toolchain, Python 3.11+, Git and ReproBit; Linux/macOS also need Wine.

The pinned README reports a cold rebuild matching all three retail binaries byte for byte. This catalog reviewed that report description and did not execute ReproBit or independently reproduce the result.
The ordinary CMake path is for development and is not the release-verification path. This repository targets 32-bit Windows only; cross-platform and Web support belongs to isle-portable.
Running the rebuilt executables still requires the original installed game data and the documented data paths. The README notes that d3drm.dll may also be needed on newer Windows systems.

The repository carries the LGPLv3 license; original game data and toolchain rights remain separate. REA involvement is not established, and no original binaries or game assets were downloaded for this review.

name: Snowball War: a bounded REA-assisted minigame reconstruction
description_en: The author uses REA’s Ghidra workflow to investigate the DOS Ski or Die binary, document Snowball War rules and rebuild that one minigame in Rust with SDL2. The public notes distinguish recovered tables and mechanics from approximations and deliberate presentation changes.
description_zh: 作者通过 REA 的 Ghidra 工作流调查 DOS 版 Ski or Die 二进制，记录 Snowball War 的规则，再用 Rust 与 SDL2 重建这一小游戏。公开笔记区分恢复的数据表和机制、近似实现以及有意调整的表现效果。
requirements: Requires the user’s matching DOS/EGA game files and Python 3 for asset extraction. The Linux build uses Rust stable (author-tested with 1.93), Cargo and SDL2 development libraries; Cargo.toml specifies the SDL2 binding 0.37.
The reported analysis used Ghidra 12.1.4 and JDK 21 through the REA CLI after unpacking EXEPACK. Caller-supplied function/code seeds are assertions, not independent discoveries by Ghidra.

Only Snowball War is reconstructed. Other events and the original engine are excluded; menus are new, and the close-up animation is deliberately restricted to the fort zone rather than reproducing every original placement.

The frame rate is approximated at 35 Hz, the original PRNG was not recovered, pause/exit keys are approximations, and audio playback is missing. Gameplay tests and static evidence do not replace the explicitly absent side-by-side comparison with the running DOS original.

The pinned LICENSE.md and Cargo.toml offer MIT OR Apache-2.0, while the README’s license sentence mentions MIT only. Original art/audio must be extracted separately; no game or test was run for this catalog.

name: SpaceCadetPinball: decompiled game logic adapted to SDL2
description_en: Converts the reverse-engineered Space Cadet pinball game into compilable C++ for desktop platforms. The README identifies the Windows XP executable and public PDB, a Full Tilt executable, and the work of recovering structures, naming variables and adapting the decompiled routines.
description_zh: 将逆向分析后的 Space Cadet 弹球游戏转为可编译的 C++，面向桌面平台。README 标明 Windows XP 可执行文件及公开 PDB、Full Tilt 可执行文件，并描述恢复结构、命名变量和适配反编译例程的工作。
requirements: Requires original game resources supplied separately. The project supports resource data from Windows and Full Tilt editions; its releases do not supply those assets.
The main project targets desktop Windows, Linux and macOS. Its list of console, mobile and browser ports points to separate projects and does not establish identical support in this repository.
Source builds require C++11, CMake, SDL2 and SDL2_mixer. The README gives Visual Studio, GCC/Clang and Xcode build paths, including x86_64 or arm64 selection on macOS.

The README reports that all subroutines were decompiled and converted to C++; this is not an independently checked byte-identical rebuild. Full Tilt feature work and possible support for its other two tables remain separate plans.
MIT license for this repository; original game resources and dependencies retain their own terms. REA use is not established; no game, compiler or external port was run for this catalog.

name: Super Mario 64: ROM reconstruction with explicit comparison gates
description_en: Reconstructs Super Mario 64 source for Japanese, North American, European, Shindou and iQue releases. Its build files distinguish original-ROM hash comparison from nonmatching or modified configurations, while source naming and documentation remain ongoing.
description_zh: 为日版、北美版、欧洲版、Shindou 版和 iQue 版 Super Mario 64 重建源码。构建文件区分原 ROM 哈希比较与非匹配或修改配置；源码命名和文档工作仍在推进。
requirements: Requires the user’s matching original ROM for asset extraction. The five target releases are separate; this repository’s reconstruction should not be confused with the separately maintained sm64ex, Ghostship or multiplayer ports.

The documented build uses GNU make, Python 3.6+, MIPS binutils, pkgconf and host development tools. Windows instructions use WSL/Linux; macOS instructions require an appropriate MIPS toolchain and newer GNU make.

The Makefile normally checks the output ROM’s SHA-1 against the selected reference. NON_MATCHING, a non-N64 target or nonstandard configurations disable comparison; a successful modified build is not a matching-result claim.

The pinned Jenkins configuration explicitly sets COMPARE=0 for iQue and enhancement builds. Its five-version build matrix therefore must not be described as five independently confirmed byte-identical results; no build or game was run for this catalog.

The repository carries CC0-1.0; original Nintendo content and any separate third-party rights are not supplied by that declaration. No REA or coding-agent involvement is established by the reviewed files.

name: Unleashed Recompiled: translating Xbox 360 game code and shaders
description_en: Builds an unofficial Sonic Unleashed PC port by statically recompiling Xbox 360 PowerPC code with XenonRecomp and Xenos shaders with XenosRecomp. The port adds modern display and modding options while documenting original-engine limits and remaining compatibility issues.
description_zh: 使用 XenonRecomp 静态重编译 Xbox 360 PowerPC 代码，并用 XenosRecomp 转换 Xenos 着色器，构建非官方 Sonic Unleashed PC 移植。项目增加现代显示与模组选项，同时记录原引擎限制和仍存在的兼容性问题。
requirements: Requires the user’s US or EU Xbox 360 game files and the title update; the Japanese release and PS3 files are unsupported by the reviewed installation guide. DLC is optional, and the project does not provide game assets.

The README’s Windows/Linux baseline includes an AVX-capable CPU, 8 GB RAM and Direct3D 12.0 with Shader Model 6 or Vulkan 1.2 graphics. It lists Windows 10 version 1909 and a modern Linux distribution such as Ubuntu 22.04.

Source builds require submodules, CMake 3.20+, C++20 tooling, vcpkg with VCPKG_ROOT configured, and matching executable/update/shader inputs. At the same revision, BUILDING.md documents Xcode 16.3+ and macOS presets while the README says macOS is not on the roadmap; this inconsistency does not establish verified macOS support.

High-frame-rate gameplay glitches, loading stutters and ultrawide cutscene issues remain documented. Mods replacing the original executable or shaders are unsupported; improvements and performance claims were not independently reproduced here.

GPLv3 project license, with separate original-game and dependency terms. This is static recompilation, not a claim to recover the original authored source; reviewed primary files do not establish REA or coding-agent involvement.

name: OpenMW: replacing Morrowind’s engine while reusing original content
description_en: Provides an independent engine for playing Morrowind and an alternative editor, OpenMW-CS. It loads original game content through its own runtime and documents script and mod compatibility differences; it is an engine replacement rather than a recovered Bethesda source tree.
description_zh: 提供用于运行 Morrowind 的独立引擎和替代编辑器 OpenMW-CS，通过自己的运行时加载原游戏内容，并记录脚本及模组兼容性差异。这是引擎替代实现，而非恢复出的 Bethesda 源码树。
requirements: Playing Morrowind requires the user’s original game data, including Morrowind.esm and the installation settings. Tribunal and Bloodmoon are optional expansions; the installation guide recommends both for best results. OpenMW-CS can also support separately authored projects.

The pinned README and build files identify version 0.52.0; this is a source-snapshot identifier, not a claim that a release was tested. The README lists Windows 10+, macOS 14.8+ and Linux, with no 32-bit support.

The source configuration uses CMake 3.16+, C++20, SDL2 2.26+, OpenSceneGraph 3.6.5+, Boost 1.70+ and OpenAL; launcher/editor/wizard builds use Qt6. Additional dependencies depend on enabled components.

The project reports the main quests as completable, but warns about side quests and mods that depend on original-engine quirks. Example Suite integration tests and the separate Morrowind-content test setup cover selected behavior, not complete original-game or mod equivalence; none was rerun here.

The official GitHub mirror points to the main GitLab project. GPLv3 covers project code, with separate font/dependency terms and original-game data rights. No REA or coding-agent involvement is established by the reviewed sources.

name: REDRIVER2: reconstructing Driver 2 through a PlayStation compatibility layer
description_en: Translates reverse-engineered Driver 2 MIPS routines into C/C++ and uses Psy-X/Psy-Cross to adapt PlayStation interfaces for desktop systems. The project documents symbol-assisted Ghidra/IDA work alongside intentional bug fixes and gameplay changes.
description_zh: 将逆向分析的 Driver 2 MIPS 例程转为 C/C++，并用 Psy-X/Psy-Cross 将 PlayStation 接口适配到桌面系统。项目记录借助符号的 Ghidra/IDA 分析，同时明确包含有意修复的错误和玩法改动。
requirements: Requires the user’s copies of both Driver 2 discs. The pinned installation wiki lists English PAL EU and NTSC US revisions 1.0/1.1; other languages remain planned. Italian/Spanish SYM files cited as decompilation inputs do not imply support for those game-data editions.

Documented play paths cover Windows and Linux; installation converts disc video/audio using Java. Linux runtime instructions list SDL2 and OpenAL; original game content is not supplied by the project.

Source builds use submodules, Premake5 and a C++ toolchain. The Windows guide uses Visual Studio 2022; Linux builds link SDL2, OpenAL, OpenGL and libjpeg. The wiki’s old Premake beta download example is not treated as a general minimum-version requirement.

The README reports a playable reconstruction but explicitly excludes the memory-card menu from its decompilation claim. Original bugs and some gameplay are deliberately changed; [D], [T] and [A] annotations distinguish decompiled, tested and altered code rather than proving whole-game fidelity.

MIT license for project code; original game data and third-party components retain their own rights. No byte-identical rebuild, independent runtime test or REA/coding-agent involvement is established by this review.

name: PhotoCraft: editor workflow reconstruction and PSD round-trip boundaries
description_en: The authors describe this Rust image editor as a clean-room reimplementation of Photoshop-style workflows. Its document engine, UI and automation interfaces share editing commands, while the source distinguishes PSD editor round trips from byte preservation in the standalone file codec.
description_zh: 作者将这款 Rust 图像编辑器描述为 Photoshop 风格流程的净室重实现。文档引擎、界面与自动化接口共用编辑命令；源码区分编辑器中的 PSD 往返处理与独立文件编解码器的字节保留。
requirements: The pinned workspace identifies version 0.9.0 and declares Rust 1.95+ for source builds with Cargo. Native and WebAssembly paths have platform-specific dependencies; optional font inputs and reference documents are separate. No build or installer was run here.

This is an implemented document/compositing engine and editing interface, not merely a screenshot mockup. It does not establish recovery of Adobe’s source code or Photoshop cloud services; the author’s clean-room characterization was not independently audited.

The editor-level corpus tests compare rendering before and after export/reimport. Separate PSD codec tests compare bytes for parseable files, with a named malformed-file exception. Editor saves are explicitly not byte-identical to their inputs; these finite test definitions are not results independently reproduced by this catalog.

The project remains alpha and distinguishes menu-command coverage from behavioral fidelity. Its dated parity assessment retains gaps in PSD exchange, typography, professional workflows, performance and plug-in compatibility; no complete Photoshop-equivalence percentage is asserted here.

Project code is MIT OR Apache-2.0, subject to NOTICE; fonts, artwork and other assets retain separate terms. ArtCraft branding is excluded; published modified versions must remove it, apart from contribution-only forks. REA use is not established, and no application assets or corpus files were downloaded for this review.

name: WordCraft: document workflow reconstruction and bounded DOCX compatibility
description_en: The authors describe WordCraft as a clean-room Rust implementation of familiar Microsoft Word workflows. It provides its own document model, layout engine and DOCX reader/writer, with desktop and browser interfaces; source tests exercise selected editing and file-preservation behavior.
description_zh: 作者将 WordCraft 描述为以 Rust 净室重实现熟悉的 Microsoft Word 流程。项目提供自己的文档模型、排版引擎和 DOCX 读写器，以及桌面与浏览器界面；源码测试覆盖选定的编辑与文件保留行为。
requirements: The pinned workspace identifies version 0.7.0 and declares Rust 1.95+ with Cargo. The documented browser build uses Trunk; native builds and faithful layout require the relevant platform dependencies and fonts. The catalog did not build the app or download reference documents.

The outcome is a document-engine and interaction implementation, not recovery of Microsoft’s source tree or Microsoft 365’s hosted backend. CLI/MCP and control-channel support are automation surfaces, not evidence that REA was used.

The reviewed DOCX tests use constructed documents and specification-based XML fixtures to check modeled properties and passthrough parts. They do not establish arbitrary-document byte identity or Word-equivalent pagination. The dated assessment against Word for Mac 16.113.4 explicitly says real-world side-by-side file/page comparisons were not performed in that assessment pass.

The project is alpha. File fidelity, page layout, advanced typography, stability and ecosystem compatibility remain limited; ribbon-command counts and author readiness estimates are not acceptance-test pass rates. No original-versus-rebuilt application test was rerun here.

Code is MIT OR Apache-2.0 with NOTICE obligations; fonts and other assets retain separate rights, and ArtCraft branding has separate restricted terms. Clean-room is the authors’ characterization, not an independently established process or legal finding; no Microsoft code or assets are provided by this catalog.

name: GridCraft: spreadsheet workflow reconstruction and XLSX round-trip limits
description_en: The authors describe GridCraft as a clean-room Rust implementation of Excel-style spreadsheet workflows. A workbook model, formula parser and dependency-driven recalculation are connected to XLSX I/O and a shared editing-command layer for desktop, browser and automation interfaces.
description_zh: 作者将 GridCraft 描述为以 Rust 净室重实现 Excel 风格的电子表格流程。工作簿模型、公式解析器与依赖驱动的重新计算连接到 XLSX 读写，以及供桌面、浏览器和自动化接口共用的编辑命令层。
requirements: The pinned workspace identifies version 0.7.0 and declares Rust 1.90+ with Cargo. Browser builds use Trunk and wasm32-unknown-unknown; native Linux CI lists X11/Wayland, GTK, fontconfig/FreeType and graphics dependencies. Fonts and input workbooks are separate; no build was run here.

Reviewed XLSX tests construct workbooks and OOXML packages, compare modeled values after writing and reading, and check selected unmodeled parts and relationships. These checks do not establish arbitrary-workbook byte identity; preserving a connection part is not implementing or refreshing its data source.

Calculation tests use expected values for selected formulas, dependency changes and spilled arrays. The dated assessment against Excel for Mac 16.113.4 says Excel was not launched and no build or test ran in that assessment pass; it also records the absence of Excel-computed conformance oracles.

The project remains alpha. Ribbon/function-name counts and readiness estimates are not behavioral-compatibility pass rates. File fidelity, advanced workflows, performance and ecosystem compatibility remain bounded, and the README documents graphics-driver startup issues. No Microsoft source tree or Microsoft 365 backend recovery is established.

Code is MIT OR Apache-2.0 with NOTICE obligations; optional fonts and ArtCraft branding have separate terms. Published modified versions must remove the ArtCraft marks, except contribution-only forks. Clean-room is the authors’ characterization, not an independently audited process; CLI/MCP support does not establish REA involvement.

name: DeckCraft: presentation workflow reconstruction and bounded PPTX interchange
description_en: The authors describe DeckCraft as a clean-room Rust implementation of PowerPoint-style presentation workflows. Its slide model, rendering and command layers support desktop/browser editing and PPTX interchange; reviewed source tests check constructed decks and selected preserved package parts.
description_zh: 作者将 DeckCraft 描述为以 Rust 净室重实现 PowerPoint 风格的演示文稿流程。其幻灯片模型、渲染与命令层支撑桌面／浏览器编辑及 PPTX 交换；所审阅源码测试检查构造的文稿和选定的保留包部件。
requirements: The pinned workspace identifies version 0.7.0 and declares Rust 1.95+ with Cargo. Linux source builds need ALSA headers and display/window dependencies; the browser path uses Trunk and wasm32-unknown-unknown. Optional craft-fonts inputs affect rendering, with system-font fallback documented; no application or asset package was downloaded or run here.

The reviewed PPTX corpus is authored in code, not collected from PowerPoint. Tests check retained text and content-part counts after saving, then part names and text after another save. Separate tests preserve selected XML metadata; they do not prove arbitrary-deck byte identity or original PowerPoint rendering.

The dated assessment against PowerPoint for Mac 16.113.4 explicitly says rendering fidelity, performance against PowerPoint and end-to-end workflows with real users’ decks were not measured in that assessment. Feature breadth and readiness percentages are checklist counts or author estimates, not acceptance-test pass rates.

The project is alpha and has documented file-exchange, presentation-workflow, stability and ecosystem gaps. Source snapshots and older assessment rows differ; no complete PowerPoint/Office equivalence, recovery of Microsoft’s authored source or reconstruction of its hosted services is asserted. The catalog did not rerun any original-versus-reimplementation comparison.

Code is MIT OR Apache-2.0 with NOTICE obligations. Fonts/icons retain separate terms, and NOTICE lists the Symphonia audio decoder under MPL-2.0. ArtCraft marks have restricted terms and must be removed from published modified versions except contribution-only forks. Clean-room remains author-attributed; automation interfaces do not establish REA use.

name: DevilutionX: porting Diablo’s reconstructed engine
description_en: Builds a modern Diablo and Hellfire port on the Devilution reconstruction, with platform support, bug fixes and optional quality-of-life features. The project documents the original symbol-assisted reconstruction and includes selected dungeon-generation and saved-game regression checks.
description_zh: 基于 Devilution 重建成果提供现代平台上的 Diablo 与 Hellfire 移植，加入平台支持、错误修复及可选便利功能。项目记录了早期借助符号信息的重建过程，并包含特定地牢生成与存档回归检查。
requirements: Full Diablo play requires the user’s original DIABDAT.MPQ. Hellfire additionally needs hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq and hfvoice.mpq. The separately offered spawn.mpq supports only the shareware portion; source availability does not supply rights to original game content.

The pinned source identifies 1.6.0-dev and requires CMake 3.22 and C++23. SDL2 is the default, with separate SDL1/SDL3 options; build documentation lists platform-dependent libraries and packaging steps. This is a source snapshot, not a tested release.

The background describes Devilution’s use of PlayStation debug symbols, assertion strings, compiler information and assembly comparisons. Its historical binary-matching milestone does not establish that the current cross-platform port, with intentional fixes and enhancements, is byte-identical to the original executable.

The reviewed timedemo test replays a warrior’s level-1-to-2 session and compares saved hero state; it skips without MPQ data and explicitly selects shareware mode. Separate dungeon tests compare seeded fixtures. These are bounded regression checks, not a complete original-versus-port equivalence result; none was run here.

The root LICENSE.md declares Sustainable Use License 1.0: use/modification is limited to internal business purposes, non-commercial use or personal use, while distribution must be free and non-commercial. Components and original game data retain separate terms.

The same snapshot retains conflicting Public Domain wording in the Windows package README and Unlicense metadata in the Apple bundle configuration. Those notices are recorded without treating the complete current project as permissively licensed or resolving the conflict. The reviewed sources do not establish REA or coding-agent involvement.

name: ThinkPad IMX471: recovering camera tuning for Linux
description_en: Recovers selected camera-tuning structures from an Intel Windows driver package and uses them to repair Linux image capture on one ThinkPad model. Public CPFF/AIQB parsers, kernel patches and libcamera changes accompany the author’s Claude-assisted investigation and bounded before/after measurements.
description_zh: 从 Intel Windows 驱动包中恢复选定的相机调校结构，用于修复一个 ThinkPad 型号在 Linux 下的图像采集。公开的 CPFF／AIQB 解析器、内核补丁及 libcamera 修改，配有作者报告的 Claude 辅助调查和有限范围的前后测量。
requirements: The reviewed target is a Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14 (Aura Edition), with a Sony IMX471 sensor behind Intel IPU7. The author tested Fedora 44 kernel 7.2.8 and a libcamera 0.7.1 backport. The published kernel package omits BTF/debug information and is described as a test kernel, not a daily-driver recommendation.

The Python 3 analysis tools use NumPy and assume a 1928x1088 RG10 stream with a 3904-byte stride. Some scripts embed the author’s local layout and need path adaptation. Repeating the tuning analysis requires the corresponding vendor driver-package data or device captures; these are separate inputs, not original-driver source recovered by this project.

The author’s controlled low-light comparison holds 400 frames for convergence and reports frame brightness rising from 31.1 to 90.9. The test record describes crop-selection, colour-bar and analogue-gain checks on the affected device. Its 46/46 v4l2-compliance passes occurred before and after the crop fix, so that pass count alone did not detect the defect. These measurements were not reproduced by this collection.

The work adds three kernel fixes plus lens-shading and white-balance-statistics changes to an existing Linux driver and software ISP. Low-light blue remains about 17% short, an 18.8 ms exposure ceiling is not fixed here, and the second IR camera is outside scope. It does not recover the entire Windows driver, emulate the laptop or establish compatibility across camera models.

The dated investigation includes corrected and withdrawn hypotheses; its final README and test record should not be replaced by earlier intermediate claims. The patch cover letter attributes Claude assistance and hardware checking to the author. The later blog reports submission/review activity, not a verified upstream merge; REA use is not established.

No top-level project license is present at the pinned revision. Newly added libcamera implementation files in the patch declare LGPL-2.1-or-later, and the tuning-data section declares CC0-1.0; these are component notices, not a blanket license for every script or vendor-derived input. Existing kernel/libcamera code and vendor materials retain their separate terms.

name: Ledger Reborn: an independent accounting app informed by QuickBooks study
description_en: The maintainer reports using REA and Ghidra to study selected QuickBooks Desktop for Mac behavior, then independently implements a local accounting application. Its Python/SQLite engine persists double-entry journals, invoices, inventory and payments, while public synthetic fixtures test bounded accounting and rollback behavior.
description_zh: 维护者报告使用 REA 与 Ghidra 研究 QuickBooks Desktop for Mac 的选定行为，随后独立实现本地记账应用。Python／SQLite 引擎持久保存复式分录、发票、库存和付款；公开合成样例检查有限范围的记账与回滚行为。
requirements: The reviewed release is 2026.10.12-preview.1. The local browser edition needs Python 3.11+; the accounting core uses the standard library and SQLite. Native desktop builds use pywebview 6.2.1, PyInstaller 6.22.3 and Pillow 12.3.0, built on the target OS; Windows additionally needs the separately installed WebView2 runtime.

The maintainer identifies QuickBooks Desktop for Mac 2024 Trial, version 23.1.13.962 R14 Trial, as the investigation target. REA 6.4.0 with Ghidra, NIB decoding and selected runtime observations informed inventory arithmetic, budget signs, reconciliation paths and layouts. The Python/SQLite engine and frontend are independently written, not recovered Intuit source.

Public synthetic fixtures contain frozen, independently specified integer-cent expectations. Reviewed tests compare reports and check atomic rollback of invalid journals, bills and inventory operations. These are implementation checks, not a complete QuickBooks conformance suite; this collection did not execute them.

The separate original-software comparison reportedly matched three official-sample reports account-by-account to the cent. The vendor sample company and exports are not public here, so that result remains author-reported. It does not establish recovered invoice lines, SKU quantities, payment links or full company-file migration.

The preview is single-user, local and USD-only. Payroll, tax filing, live bank/payment services, multicurrency and complete QuickBooks migration are outside the implementation. Its cash-basis output is a defined management cash view, not established equivalence with all original or tax rules; full visual/interaction parity also remains unverified.

MIT covers the authored application; vendor inputs and bundled runtime dependencies keep separate terms. The preview is not Developer ID-signed or notarized on macOS and lacks Windows publisher signing. Package smoke tests and selected native-window observations have separate scopes; no installer, original application, vendor company data or runtime package was downloaded or executed for this review.

name: rauchg.com: rebuilding an RSC blog from captured Flight output
description_en: Documents a website-rebuild-skill case that decodes browser-delivered React Server Component Flight streams, reconstructs a buildable Next project and compares its output with a captured site. The reported rauchg.com campaign uses route-tree comparison and module-reference mapping; the new server source is inferred from observable output.
description_zh: 记录 website-rebuild-skill 的一个案例：解码浏览器收到的 React 服务端组件 Flight 流，重建可构建的 Next 项目，再与捕获站点的输出比较。作者报告的 rauchg.com 重建过程采用路由树比较与模块引用映射；新服务端源码由可观察输出推断。
requirements: The documented rauchg.com snapshot used Next 16.1.1, Turbopack and React 19 canary. The tooling requires Node.js 22+ and a local Chrome/Chromium for comparison; some stages invoke version-pinned external tools. Repeating the method needs an authorized target snapshot and a separately built reconstruction, not just the skill repository.

Flight decoding exposes delivered element trees, route state and client-module references. The reconstructed server-component source is explicitly an inference from that output; flight-to-mdx also needs site-specific shape/link adaptations. This is not extraction of undistributed server source or automatic recovery of an arbitrary Next.js application.

The author reports 18/18 routes passing a Flight semantic gate and a runtime sweep for this case. The gate compares normalized trees and enforces a global module-ID bijection. It normalizes build-hash namespaces and selected encoding differences; configured prop/class exclusions can omit registered fields or subtrees. A pass is not byte identity or full behavioral equivalence.

The gate does not check CSS, so layout, fonts and rendered pixels need separate comparisons. Public synthetic self-tests include changed-text rejection and rejection of a one-to-many module mapping. This review inspected those checks as source and did not run them or reproduce the reported website campaign.

The method explicitly leaves unobserved error responses, database/write paths, server caches, dynamic-image generator source and unlinked routes unresolved. Historical public-source comparisons and reported reconstruction percentages do not prove access to hidden backend logic; the author also notes possible model-training familiarity with a nominally blind target.

MIT applies to the skill and tooling, not to reconstructed websites, their scripts, fonts or other assets. The source documents separate authorization/publication decisions and private, noindex output defaults.
